load_bearing_verifications.claim: The current US label contains no gout, hyperuricemia, uric-acid, or urate adverse reaction or warning.
The current US label's joint warning concerns arthralgia and psoriatic arthritis, and its controlled indication tables show only small arthralgia imbalances rather than gout.
Current EMA product information contains no gout or hyperuricemia and lists arthralgia as common with a postmarketing-source footnote.
The initial EMA assessment report contains no gout, hyperuricemia, uric-acid, or urate finding.
The two records returned by the direct PubMed gout-or-urate query do not report dupilumab-induced gout or hyperuricemia.

limitations: FAERS lacks a denominator and the captured fields do not establish event chronology, incidence, or causality.
PubMed snapshots were capped at 25 records per query; capped searches are marked partial.
CQVIP and J-STAGE broad term matching prevented exact paired-query counts; inspected records were bounded as stated.
Controlled safety evidence was read through current regulatory tables and assessments rather than every individual clinical-study report.
errors: Initial sandboxed PubMed and local-curl attempts failed at DNS; approved local-network reruns succeeded.
Direct FDA PDF downloads through local curl returned the FDA automated-request apology page; the current label and regulatory review were inspected through the FDA-hosted browser documents.
